new_evidence.evots: On Bee-Dance/GPT-5.4, full EvoTS-Agent F1 is 0.635±0.04 versus 0.578±0.06 without Alternative Strategy and 0.575±0.12 without Recombination. The paper states chronological 60/20/20 splits and test annotations/metrics hidden throughout optimization. Full does not dominate Hausdorff, so scope is F1/precision-recall tradeoff rather than all-metric superiority.
new_evidence.adias: Under the paper's same 10 optimization iterations, 15 training episodes per iteration and held-out-test protocol, Full ADIAS averages 88.8 on Tau-Bench/ALFWorld/TextCraft versus 73.8 for Best-Candidate Revision and 54.5 for Latest-Candidate Continuation. This supports persistent repair state as active optimization control rather than passive memory.
new_evidence.adias_provenance: Current public ADIAS source implements profile/best/latest selection, but code was published after paper submission and current default scripts differ from the headline protocol; exact paper executable/results remain unbound.
